info.bio:
El trio formado por Ben Folds, Darren Jessee y Robert Sledge con excelente sentido del humor y una inteligencia poco vista en el pop fue capaz de producir albumes como Whatever and ever amen o Naked baby Photos. Sus canciones son sarcásticas y con algo de humor negro como en Song for the Dumped o increiblemente trabajadas y bellas como en Magic.

El último trabajo de la banda fue en 1999 con The Unauthorized Biography of Reinhold Messner. Suceso que dio pie a la fructífera carrera solista de Ben Folds, lider de la banda.

scenes.name: Renacimiento pop, Elephant 6 y lounge-pop
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: En la primera mitad de los noventa el pop supera ampliamente a la música experimental: la revancha de la melodía tras un cuarto de siglo de sonidos progresivos. La vía más rentable sigue el pop barroco de los últimos Beach Boys, Van Dyke Parks, Big Star y XTC: Jellyfish (Bellybutton), Imperial Teen, Velvet Crush, Material Issue, Eggs, Fountains Of Wayne, Ben Folds Five, Chainsaw Kittens, Barenaked Ladies. El colectivo «Elephant 6» de Georgia y Luisiana es la escuela pop más influyente de la década: Apples In Stereo, Olivia Tremor Control, Neutral Milk Hotel (In The Aeroplane Over The Sea), Elf Power, Of Montreal; y sus herederos Ladybug Transistor y Photon Band. El folk-pop a lo Tom Petty y R.E.M.; el «lounge-pop» (Combustible Edison, Zumpano, Ivy, Cardigans, Squirrel Nut Zippers); el teen-pop (Hanson, Britney Spears, Backstreet Boys).

podcast.title: Formation in North Carolina
podcast.body: Ben Folds Five was formed after Ben Folds relocated back home to North Carolina, a move that proved to be a turning point after a series of unsuccessful musical endeavors. This formation marked the beginning of the band's successful career. "It wasn't until he moved back home to North Carolina and formed a band he called Ben Foltz Five that things started to click."

podcast.title: Unique "Punk Rock for Sissies" Style
podcast.body: The band's music was uniquely described by Ben Folds as "Punk Rock for Sissies." This label highlights their distinctive approach of combining punk sensibilities with a piano-centric sound, setting them apart from traditional guitar-driven punk bands. "He called his music, Punk Rock for Sissies."

xref.title: Diverse Post-Ben Folds Five Career
xref.body: Since his time with Ben Folds Five, Ben Folds has pursued a highly varied career, releasing solo albums, collaborating with diverse artists like William Shatner and "Weird Al" Yankovic, composing Hollywood film soundtracks, acting, judging an NBC talent show, serving as an artistic director for a symphony orchestra, hosting a podcast, and writing a memoir. This extensive range of activities demonstrates his versatile talents. "Since then, Ben Foltz has released a number of albums on his own, collaborated with everyone from William Shatton or to Weird Al, written soundtracks for Hollywood films, Dunsome Acting, appeared as a judge on an NBC talent show, served as an artistic director to a symphony orchestra, hosted a podcast and written a memoir."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Formation of Ben Folds Five and "Punk Rock for Sissies"
xref.body: After numerous dead ends with other bands and gigs, Ben Folds found success upon moving back home to North Carolina and forming Ben Folds Five. He characterized their unique sound as "Punk Rock for Sissies," defining a style that blended punk energy with piano-driven melodies. "It wasn't until he moved back home to North Carolina and formed a band he called Ben Foltz Five that things started to click. He called his music, Punk Rock for Sissies."
